profiles.name: Papa
profiles.aboutText: Papa is in Primary 1. He loves counting, colours, and singing songs. Every day he learns something new and exciting.

profiles.name: Kukus
profiles.aboutText: Kukus is in Primary 4. He enjoys Maths puzzles, reading stories, and discovering how things work. He's always up for a challenge.

profiles.name: Adom
profiles.aboutText: Adom is in Primary 5. He's passionate about Science and loves exploring how the world works — from flowers to electricity. This Study Hub was built for him and his siblings.

profiles.name: KiKI
profiles.aboutText: KiKI is in JHS 2. She's focused on preparing for BECE and loves studying Mathematics and Integrated Science. She's also great at helping her younger siblings.

profiles.name: Guest
profiles.aboutText: Study Hub is a free learning app for Ghanaian students. No ads. No cost. Works offline. Built by parents, for our children.
